purpose: Act with an assumed role or imagined situation in mind.
keywords: Plain form + つもりで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + つもりで
Try explaining it as if you were the teacher.
I saved that amount of money as if I had spent it on a trip.
Let us practice as though this were the real performance.
formation: Plain form + つもりで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + つもりで
restrictions: The imagined frame guides the action; it need not be literally true.
mistake: This can mean “as if,” rather than an ordinary future plan.
